name: jovian/bdd-steps
description: High-velocity, zero-trait BDD step definitions and execution primitives for modern PHP 8.3+ and Drupal architectures.

suggest.drupal/drupal-extension: Required in require-dev when using any Drupal trait (DrevOps\BehatSteps\Drupal\*).
suggest.softcreatr/jsonpath: Required in require-dev for JsonTrait JSON path steps (the JSON path ... should ...).
suggest.justinrainbow/json-schema: Required in require-dev for the JSON Schema steps.
suggest.lullabot/mink-selenium2-driver: One JavaScript-capable Mink driver for @javascript scenarios (alternative: dmore/behat-chrome-extension).
suggest.dmore/behat-chrome-extension: Headless Chrome Mink driver over CDP for @javascript scenarios (alternative: lullabot/mink-selenium2-driver).
